mapper.select: SELECT account_id, remaining_days, version FROM leave_ledger WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
SELECT id, unit_id, start_date, end_date, status FROM leave_request WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_ledger (account_id, remaining_days, version) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{remainingDays}, #{version}) ON CONFLICT (account_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO leave_request (id, account_id, unit_id, start_date, end_date, status) VALUES (#{request.id}, #{accountId}, #{request.unitId}, #{request.startDate}, #{request.endDate}, #{request.status}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status WHERE leave_request.status <> EXCLUDED.status
